content.short: KiiChain, an on-chain FX layer for stablecoins and RWAs aimed at emerging markets.
content.description: Kii builds financial infrastructure for Latin America and other emerging markets. Its products are KII, a hybrid exchange for cross-border payments and currency trading, and KiiChain, a network designed for swapping between stablecoins in different currencies and real-world assets. The goal is to make it cheaper for businesses and people in these markets to move money internationally.
content.meta: Kii builds KiiChain and a hybrid exchange for FX and cross-border payments in stablecoins across emerging markets.
